content.text:
Create a 15-second historical Chinese INK PAINTING SCROLL ANIMATION. The entire film stays a flat hand-painted illustration on one long continuous parchment. NOT live action, NOT miniature 3D people on paper, NOT a table scene. Absolutely NO typography, no Chinese characters, no numbers, no captions, no border boxes, no labels, no panels. The reference image supplies only generic Han-period warehouse clothing and grain bags; do not reproduce its photographic look.
The scroll shows FIVE DISTINCT places connected by one winding ink road, ordered left to right: village official issuing a blank wooden levy tally; villagers pouring actual grain into a measuring basket; porters carrying filled bags across the warehouse threshold into storage; warehouse dispatchers loading bags onto a wooden cart as a different clerk releases it; at the far right a military grain-team receiver takes a bag off the arriving cart into his own arms. These are a generic process, no quantities, no shortage reveal, no guilt or answer.
0-2s: camera follows the issuing official handing the blank tally to a villager at the far left, this clearly represents the demand before actual collection.
2-4s: glide right along road to the actual villagers pouring grain into measuring basket; end on filled sack.
4-6s: continue right to porters carrying that sack THROUGH warehouse door into storage. Show the threshold crossing clearly.
6-8s: continue right to the dispatch side: clerk gestures permission and porters load a sack onto cart; cart departs to the right.
8-10s: continue right to a clearly separate army receiving point, a soldier takes a sack FROM arriving cart and holds it. Show handoff contact and release, not another loading shot.
10-15s: pull out enough to show all FIVE places simultaneously on the same connected road. A real human index fingertip enters from bottom at the far RIGHT military receiving point, slowly traces the ink road BACKWARDS through dispatch/cart, warehouse, measured collection, and finally ends at the far LEFT levy-tally official. Camera follows finger continuously right-to-left. Nothing runs physically backwards. Do not replay earlier action clips. Do not add text or speech.
Voice whitelist EMPTY. No voices, no narration, no reading any production instructions. No BGM, no background music, no score. Only quiet parchment rustle, gentle grain pour, sack contact, soft footsteps and wooden cart sounds synchronized to the illustration.
